instruction: Browse the list of men's Nike shorts under $50.

metadata.explanation: This task is a variation of the original NBA store browsing task. The agent must navigate to the NBA store and apply filters to browse men's Nike shorts under $50. The evaluator uses the existing get_active_tab_html_parse getter with category 'class&url' to check both the filter elements on the page (class_multiObject) and the URL parameters (url_include_expected). The metric check_direct_json_object compares the result against expected filter values. This maintains similar complexity to the original task - same number of filters (4), same interaction pattern (navigate and filter), same evaluation approach.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can properly verify the instruction
Complete coverage: All 4 filter requirements (under $50, men, shorts, nike) are verified
Dual verification approach: Checks both page UI elements (class 'filter-selector-link') AND URL parameters
Expected values are semantically correct: All filters should be true, no unexpected filters (is_other_exist=false)
Data flow is correct: Getter returns boolean dict, metric performs direct comparison
Practical feasibility: Getter can access active tab HTML via Playwright and extract filter state
Case sensitivity is handled consistently: Lowercase conversion throughout the pipeline
